subject: Operations
title: ABC Analysis
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: ABC Analysis.

hook.text: A warehouse has 10,000 items. Only 500 generate 80% of revenue. Treat those 500 like royalty.

buildup.text: ABC ranks items: A items are high-value, B items moderate, C items low-value.

discovery.text: A items get tight controls and frequent counts. C items get simple rules. Resources match value.

twist.text: A cheap C-item can shut down an assembly line if it runs out. Value isn't the only factor.

climax.text: Smart companies combine ABC with criticality—a $2 bolt that stops production is treated as an A item.

punchline.text: Not all items are equal. Manage them that way.

quiz.question: What do A items represent in ABC analysis?
